name: PC-FMCW/DPSK Physical and Link Layer
purpose: Freeze the Part-A-derived communication mapping used to convert future WOMD geometry into communication state.
work_items: map range/bearing/pointing/FoV/atmospheric terms to link state
derive SNR, BER, PER, delivered goodput, outage and usable-link lifetime
acceptance_criteria: canonical BER LUT is reproducible for frozen seed/config
all scheduler experiments reference the same LUT hash
link outputs remain finite and within physical/domain bounds
outage and usable-link definitions are explicit and frozen
paper wording separates real WOMD motion from model-based communication
forbidden: introducing an unrelated second physical-layer model
calling simulated optical channel outputs measured WOMD data
changing link thresholds after official held-out evaluation
